args.message: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded recursion in deeply nested arrays)

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

Per the advisory, affected versions are <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4 (and 3.1.0). Since the project currently pins the 2.x series, this PR bumps the pin to 2.9.4 — the minimal, safe fix within the same major version.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**

## Review
Requesting review from @alex (code owner).
